name: What preparation should I do before trim and molding installation?
description: Prepare by cleaning walls, removing old trim carefully, completing wall painting, and allowing new trim materials to acclimate to your home's humidity.

mainEntity.name: What preparation should I do before trim and molding installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before installation, ensure walls are clean and free of debris. If old trim is being replaced, remove it carefully to minimize wall damage. For painting, ensure your walls are painted to their final color before trim installation. Consider having your preferred trim material on-site for a few days before installation to allow it to acclimate to your home's humidity levels, preventing warping. Clear furniture from the work areas to provide unobstructed access for installers.
acceptedAnswer.description: Prepare by cleaning walls, removing old trim carefully, completing wall painting, and allowing new trim materials to acclimate to your home's humidity.
